entity.summary: On-chain trading ecosystem offering leveraged perpetual markets and short-cycle event contracts through a retail-oriented trading interface.
entity.notes: Current first-party surfaces describe active perpetual markets, event contracts, published rules, and verifiable on-chain market logic. Current independent metrics report non-zero perpetual and spot volume plus TVL across BNB Chain and Solana. Confidence remains medium because detailed execution and custody architecture is not fully established by the reviewed public sources. No exact launch date, legal jurisdiction, predecessor, successor, or terminal lifecycle fact is asserted.
